name: Njikwa Ọrụ (Project Management) site n'AI
objectives: Mgbe e nyere gị isi ihe gbasara ezi project ma ọ bụ nke omume, ide charter otu peeji nke na-ekwu ebumnuche, oke ọrụ (scope), sponsor, ego, ụbọchị njedebe na ihe ga-egosi ihe ịga nke ọma, ma dozie mperi AI ọ bụla ma dee na sponsor kwetara
Site na charter gị, ime nkewa ọrụ (WBS) na usoro oge nwere ogologo oge ọrụ, ọrụ ndị dabere n'ibe ha na milestone, nwere opekata mpe milestone anọ na atụmatụ oge AI e lelere
Mgbe e nyere gị isi ọrụ nke project ahụ, iwu chaatị RACI nke na-egosi onye bụ Responsible, Accountable, Consulted na Informed, nwere naanị otu onye Accountable n'ọrụ ọ bụla na ọrụ kesara nke ọma
Mgbe e nyere gị ihe egwu project AI chepụtara, ịtụ ọkwa ihe egwu ise kacha bụrụ eziokwu ma họrọ nzaghachi na onye nwe ya maka nke ọ bụla, na-eji avoid, reduce, transfer ma ọ bụ accept nke ọma
Maka otu izu nke project ahụ, ide akụkọ ọnọdụ ọkara peeji nwere ọnọdụ uhie, odo ma ọ bụ akwụkwọ ndụ n'eziokwu na mkpebi a chọrọ, ma lelee ụbọchị na nọmba ọ bụla
Na njedebe nke project, ime nnyocha ihe mmụta n'enweghị ịta ụta ma mechie project ahụ site n'iji ya tụnyere charter, na-aza ajụjụ nnyocha anọ niile ma na-echekwa faịlụ ndị ahụ

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 1: Ide project charter site n'AI
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 1 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 5
Ebumnuche: Dee charter otu peeji nke na-akọwa ebumnuche project, oke ọrụ ya na ihe ịga nke ọma.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe e nyere gị isi ihe gbasara ezi project ma ọ bụ nke omume, ị ga-enwe ike ide charter otu peeji nke na-ekwu ebumnuche, oke ọrụ (scope), sponsor, ego, ụbọchị njedebe na ihe ga-egosi ihe ịga nke ọma, ma dozie mperi AI ọ bụla ma dee na sponsor kwetara.
Project charter bụ asambodo ọmụmụ nke project. Ọ na-ekwu ihe mere project ahụ ji dị, ihe ọ ga-enye, ihe dị n'ime na n'èzí oke ọrụ ya, onye bụ sponsor, ego na ụbọchị njedebe a tụrụ anya, na otu ị ga-esi mara na ọ gara nke ọma. Ọ dị ka iwu mmemme agha (mission order): ebumnuche, ọnọdụ njedebe, oke.
Nye AI eziokwu ka o dee ihe mbụ: "Dee project charter otu peeji. Project: ihe ngosi ọrụ maka veterans n'ụlọ obodo na March 15. Ebumnuche: ndị were mmadụ n'ọrụ 30, ndị bịara 200. Ego: $3,000. Sponsor: onye isi ụlọ obodo ahụ. N'èzí oke: nri karịa kọfị."
Wee dozie ya. AI nwere ike ichepụta nọmba, ndị metụtara project ma ọ bụ ebumnuche. Eziokwu ọ bụla ga-abụ nke gị. Mee ka sponsor kweta na charter tupu ọrụ amalite; ọ na-egbochi esemokwu e mesịa gbasara ihe project ahụ kwesịrị ime.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Dee ebumnuche, ihe mgbaru ọsọ, ụbọchị njedebe, ego na sponsor.
- Depụta ihe dị n'ime na n'èzí oke ọrụ.
- Rịọ AI ka o dee charter otu peeji.
- Dozie ihe ọ bụla AI chepụtara.
- Nweta nkwenye sponsor.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Project charter: obere akwụkwọ na-enye ikike ka project malite ma na-ekwu ebumnuche ya, oke ọrụ ya na oke ya.
- Scope (oke ọrụ): ọrụ project ahụ ga-arụ na nke ọ gaghị arụ.
- Sponsor: onye na-akwado ma na-akwado project ahụ n'ikike.
- Stakeholder: onye ọ bụla project ahụ metụtara ma ọ bụ nọ n'ime ya.
Nwaa ugbu a: Họrọ ezi project ma ọ bụ nke omume. Dee isi eziokwu ya, mee ka AI dee charter otu peeji, ma kaa akara n'ihe niile i doziri.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ide project charter otu peeji site n'enyemaka AI.

check.q: Gịnị ka scope (oke ọrụ) pụtara na project charter?
options: Ihe project ahụ ga-eme na nke ọ gaghị eme
check.why: Scope na-egosi oke project ahụ: ihe dị n'ime na ihe dị n'èzí.

check.q: Charter AI dere nwere ego ị na-enyeghị ya. Gịnị ka ị ga-eme?
options: Hapụ ya n'ihi na ọ dị ka ọ ziri ezi
Jiri ezi ego sitere n'aka sponsor dochie ya ma kaa akara na i doziri ya
Gwa ndị otu ka ha tụọ vootu maka ego
check.why: AI na-eji nkọ jupụta oghere; ezi ego na-esi n'aka sponsor.

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 2: Ikewa ọrụ na ịhazi oge ya
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 2 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 6
Ebumnuche: Gbanwee charter ka ọ bụrụ nkewa ọrụ (WBS) na usoro oge nwere milestone.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Site na charter gị, ị ga-enwe ike ime nkewa ọrụ (WBS) na usoro oge nwere ogologo oge ọrụ, ọrụ ndị dabere n'ibe ha na milestone, nwere opekata mpe milestone anọ na atụmatụ oge AI e lelere.
Work breakdown structure (WBS) na-ekewa project niile n'iberibe ndị pere mpe ruo mgbe iberibe ọ bụla bụ ọrụ otu onye nwere ike ịrụ n'ime ụbọchị ole na ole. Maka ihe ngosi ọrụ: ebe a ga-eme ya, ndị were mmadụ n'ọrụ, mgbasa ozi, ndị ọrụ afọ ofufo, ihe a ga-eme n'ụbọchị ahụ, nsochi; nke ọ bụla kewara n'ọrụ.
Jụọ AI: "Site na charter a, mee WBS nwere usoro na ọrụ. Wee tụọ ogologo oge ọrụ ọ bụla ga-ewe ma depụta ọrụ ndị dabere n'ọrụ ndị ọzọ." Ọrụ ndị dabere n'ibe ha dị mkpa: ị pụghị ibipụta flaya ruo mgbe e kwadoro ebe na ụbọchị.
Tinye ya n'usoro oge na spreadsheet ma ọ bụ ngwa n'efu, na-amalite na ụbọchị njedebe na-alaghachi azụ. Kaa akara milestone, ya bụ isi ebe nlele dị ka "e nwetala ebe" ma ọ bụ "ndị were mmadụ n'ọrụ 20 ekwetala". Jiri ahụmahụ gị lelee atụmatụ oge AI; ọ na-echekarị na ihe ga-adị ngwa karịa ka ọ dị.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Rịọ AI maka WBS nwere usoro na ọrụ.
- Kewaa ọrụ ọ bụla karịrị ụbọchị ole na ole.
- Tinye ogologo oge na ọrụ ndị dabere n'ibe ha.
- Hazie oge site na ụbọchị njedebe na-alaghachi azụ.
- Kaa akara opekata mpe milestone anọ.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- WBS: work breakdown structure: project niile e kewara n'obere ọrụ.
- Dependency (ọrụ dabere n'ọzọ): ọrụ na-enweghị ike ịmalite ruo mgbe ọrụ ọzọ gwụrụ.
- Milestone: isi ebe nlele n'ime project.
Nwaa ugbu a: Jiri AI mee WBS maka project gị, wee wuo usoro oge dị mfe na spreadsheet nwere ogologo oge, ọrụ dabere n'ibe ha na opekata mpe milestone anọ.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ikewa project n'ọrụ ma hazie oge ha nwere milestone.

options: Isi ebe na-egosi na nnukwu akụkụ agwụla
check.why: Milestone na-egosi isi ihe e mezuru, dị ka "e nwetala ebe".

check.q: WBS gị nwere ọrụ a kpọrọ "Hazie mmemme ahụ" nke ga-ewe izu isii. Gịnị ka ị ga-eme?
options: Hapụ ya ka ọ bụrụ otu ọrụ
Kewaa ya n'obere ọrụ otu onye nwere ike ịrụ n'ime ụbọchị ole na ole
check.why: Ọrụ WBS kwesịrị ịdị obere nke na otu onye ga-arụ ya n'ime ụbọchị ole na ole.

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 3: Ikenye ọrụ site na chaatị RACI
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 3 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 5
Ebumnuche: Wuo chaatị RACI ka onye ọ bụla mara onye na-arụ, onye na-ekpebi na onye a na-agwa.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe e nyere gị isi ọrụ nke project ahụ, ị ga-enwe ike iwu chaatị RACI nke na-egosi onye bụ Responsible, Accountable, Consulted na Informed, nwere naanị otu onye Accountable n'ọrụ ọ bụla na ọrụ kesara nke ọma.
Mgbagwoju anya gbasara onye na-eme gịnị na-emebi project. Chaatị RACI na-edepụta ọrụ n'akụkụ, ndị mmadụ n'elu, ma na-akaa akara n'igbe ọ bụla: R maka Responsible (na-arụ ọrụ ahụ), A maka Accountable (nwe ihe si na ya pụta ma bịanye aka; naanị otu n'ọrụ ọ bụla), C maka Consulted (na-enye echiche) na I maka Informed (a na-agwa ihe na-eme).
Jụọ AI: "Mee chaatị RACI maka ọrụ na ọrụ ndị a: [ọrụ], [ndị mmadụ ma ọ bụ ọrụ ha]." Wee lelee: ọrụ ọ bụla ọ nwere naanị otu A? Onye ọ bụla ọ nwere R karịrị akarị? Ọ dị onye a na-ajụ (Consulted) maka ihe niile, na-eme ka ihe nwayọọ?
Kesaa RACI ahụ ndị otu na sponsor. Mgbe ajụjụ biara, dị ka onye na-akwado flaya, gosi chaatị ahụ.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Depụta isi ọrụ na ndị mmadụ ma ọ bụ ọrụ ha.
- Rịọ AI ka o dee chaatị RACI.
- Lelee na ọrụ ọ bụla nwere naanị otu A.
- Kesaa R nke ọma ka o buru onye ọ bụla ibu karịa.
- Kesaa ya ndị otu na sponsor.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Chaatị RACI: tebụl na-egosi onye bụ Responsible, Accountable, Consulted na Informed maka ọrụ ọ bụla.
- Accountable: otu onye nwe ihe si n'ọrụ pụta ma bịanye aka.
Nwaa ugbu a: Mee ka AI dee chaatị RACI maka isi ọrụ project gị. Dozie ya ka ọrụ ọ bụla nwee naanị otu A ma ọrụ kesaa nke ọma.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike iwu na ilele chaatị RACI nke na-eme ka ọrụ onye ọ bụla doo anya.

check.q: Na chaatị RACI, gịnị ka "C" pụtara?
options: Consulted: a na-ajụ ya echiche tupu mkpebi
check.why: Ndị Consulted na-enye echiche tupu ọrụ ma ọ bụ mkpebi.

check.q: A kaara mmadụ abụọ akara Accountable n'otu ọrụ. Gịnị ka ị ga-eme?
options: Họrọ otu onye ka ọ bụrụ Accountable
Hapụ ha abụọ ka ọrụ gwụ
check.why: Ọrụ ọ bụla chọrọ naanị otu onye Accountable nwe ihe si na ya pụta.

chapters.name: Isi 2: Iduzi na imechi project ahụ

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 4: Idebe ndekọ ihe egwu
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 4 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 5
Ebumnuche: Chọpụta, tụọ ọkwa ma hazie nzaghachi maka ihe egwu project site n'enyemaka AI.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Mgbe e nyere gị ihe egwu project AI chepụtara, ị ga-enwe ike ịtụ ọkwa ihe egwu ise kacha bụrụ eziokwu ma họrọ nzaghachi na onye nwe ya maka nke ọ bụla, na-eji avoid, reduce, transfer ma ọ bụ accept nke ọma.
Ihe egwu (risk) bụ ihe nwere ike ime ma metụta project ahụ. Ndekọ ihe egwu (risk register) na-edepụta ihe egwu ọ bụla, ka o nwere ike isi mee, otu mmetụta ya ga-esi njọ, atụmatụ nzaghachi na onye nwe ya na-eche ya nche.
Jụọ AI: "Depụta ihe egwu iri maka project a [tinye charter], tụọ ohere na mmetụta dị ka low, medium ma ọ bụ high, ma tụọ aro nzaghachi maka nke ọ bụla." Nzaghachi: zere ya (avoid), belata ya (reduce), nyefee ya (transfer, dịka ọmụmaatụ inshọransị ma ọ bụ nkwekọrịta) ma ọ bụ nabata ya (accept) nwere atụmatụ ndabere.
Debe naanị ihe egwu ndị bụ eziokwu maka project gị, tinye ndị AI hapụrụ, ma lelee ndekọ ahụ kwa izu. Ndị na-ahazi agha na-akpọ nke a iche echiche banyere alaka na ihe ga-esote (branches and sequels); ndị nkịtị na-akpọ ya njikwa ihe egwu.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Rịọ AI ka o chepụta ihe egwu site na charter gị.
- Tụọ ohere na mmetụta.
- Họrọ nzaghachi: avoid, reduce, transfer ma ọ bụ accept.
- Nye ihe egwu ọ bụla onye nwe ya.
- Lelee ndekọ ahụ kwa izu.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Ihe egwu (risk): ihe nwere ike ime ma metụta project ahụ.
- Ndekọ ihe egwu (risk register): ndepụta ihe egwu nwere ọkwa, nzaghachi na ndị nwe ha.
- Mitigation: nzọụkwụ iji belata ohere ma ọ bụ mmetụta nke ihe egwu.
Nwaa ugbu a: Mee ka AI chepụta ihe egwu maka project gị. Debe ise kacha bụrụ eziokwu, tụọ ọkwa ha, họrọ nzaghachi ma nye ha ndị nwe ha.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike iwu na idebe ndekọ ihe egwu site n'enyemaka AI.

check.q: Kedu nzaghachi ihe egwu pụtara ime ka ihe egwu ghara ime ngwa ngwa ma ọ bụ mebie obere?
check.why: Ibelata na-eme ka ohere ma ọ bụ mmebi nke ihe egwu dị ala.

check.q: AI depụtara ihe egwu 25 nwere ike ime maka ihe ngosi ọrụ gị. Gịnị ka ị ga-eme?
options: Debe ise kacha bụrụ eziokwu, tụọ ọkwa ha ma nye ha ndị nwe ha
check.why: Ndekọ bara uru na-elekwasị anya n'ihe egwu kacha bụrụ eziokwu, nke ọ bụla nwere nzaghachi na onye nwe ya.

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 5: Ide akụkọ ọnọdụ ndị mmadụ na-agụ
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 5 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 5
Ebumnuche: Dee obere akụkọ ọnọdụ kwa izu nwere ọnọdụ uhie, odo ma ọ bụ akwụkwọ ndụ doro anya.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Maka otu izu nke project ahụ, ị ga-enwe ike ide akụkọ ọnọdụ ọkara peeji nwere ọnọdụ uhie, odo ma ọ bụ akwụkwọ ndụ n'eziokwu na mkpebi a chọrọ, ma lelee ụbọchị na nọmba ọ bụla.
Akụkọ ọnọdụ (status report) na-agwa sponsor na ndị otu ihe na-eme. Mee ka ọ bụrụ ọkara peeji: ọnọdụ n'ozuzu (akwụkwọ ndụ na-aga nke ọma, odo nọ n'ihe egwu, uhie apụọla n'ụzọ), ihe e mere n'izu a, ihe na-esote, ihe egwu na nsogbu, na mkpebi a chọrọ n'aka sponsor.
Tinye mmelite usoro oge gị na ndetu gị n'AI ma jụọ: "Dee akụkọ ọnọdụ kwa izu ọkara peeji nwere agba ọnọdụ n'ozuzu, ihe e mezuru, nzọụkwụ na-esote, ihe egwu na nsogbu, na mkpebi a chọrọ. Kwuo ya ozugbo."
Kwuo eziokwu banyere odo na uhie. Akụkọ ọjọọ n'oge bụ onyinye: ọ na-enye sponsor oge inyere aka. Izo nsogbu ruo ụbọchị njedebe bụ ụzọ kacha ngwa isi tufuo ntụkwasị obi. Lelee ụbọchị na nọmba ọ bụla AI dere.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Melite usoro oge na ndekọ ihe egwu.
- Tinye ndetu na mmelite n'AI.
- Rịọ maka akụkọ ọkara peeji nwere agba ọnọdụ.
- Lelee ụbọchị na nọmba ọ bụla.
- Ziga ya n'otu ụbọchị kwa izu.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Akụkọ ọnọdụ (status report): mmelite a na-enye mgbe niile gbasara ọganihu, ihe egwu na mkpa project.
- Issue (nsogbu): nsogbu na-eme ugbu a, n'adịghị ka ihe egwu nwere ike ime.
- RAG status: red, amber (odo) ma ọ bụ green: ngosi ngwa ngwa nke ahụike project.
Nwaa ugbu a: Site n'enyemaka AI, dee akụkọ ọnọdụ kwa izu maka project gị (izu 3 n'ezie ma ọ bụ nke e chepụtara). Tinye agba ọnọdụ n'eziokwu na opekata mpe otu mkpebi a chọrọ.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ide akụkọ ọnọdụ kwa izu doro anya ma bụrụ eziokwu site n'enyemaka AI.

options: E nwere nsogbu nwere ike imetụta atụmatụ ma ọ bụrụ na e dozighị ya
check.why: Odo bụ ịdọ aka na ntị: ọ nọ n'ihe egwu mana a ka nwere ike idozi ya.

check.q: Ị chọrọ ka sponsor kwado ego ọzọ n'izu a. Gịnị ka ị ga-eme n'akụkọ ọnọdụ?
options: Hapụ ya ka akụkọ ahụ nọgide na akwụkwọ ndụ
Tinye ya na peeji nke atọ
Kwuo ya naanị ihu na ihu n'ọnwa na-abịa
Depụta ya nke ọma n'okpuru mkpebi a chọrọ
check.why: Mkpebi a chọrọ kwesịrị ịdị mfe ịhụ ka sponsor nwee ike ime ihe.

lessons.title: Ihe ọmụmụ 6: Imechi project na ịchịkọta ihe mmụta
lessons.text:
Ihe ọmụmụ 6 n'ime 6 · ihe dị ka nkeji 5
Ebumnuche: Mechie project nke ọma ma mee nnyocha ihe mmụta.
Ihe ọmụmụ a na-akwado gị maka: Na njedebe nke project, ị ga-enwe ike ime nnyocha ihe mmụta n'enweghị ịta ụta ma mechie project ahụ site n'iji ya tụnyere charter, na-aza ajụjụ nnyocha anọ niile ma na-echekwa faịlụ ndị ahụ.
Ọtụtụ project na-akwụsị otu a. Imechi ya nke ọma na-akwado na e mezuru ebumnuche (tụnyere ya na charter), na-enyefe ihe ọ bụla na-aga n'ihu, na-akwụ ụgwọ ikpeazụ, na-ekele ndị otu ma na-echekwa faịlụ ebe ndị ọzọ ga-ahụ ha.
Nnyocha ihe mmụta (lessons learned), dị ka nnyocha mgbe mmemme gachara (after-action review), na-ajụ: gịnị ka anyị zubere, gịnị mere, gịnị kpatara ya, gịnị ka anyị kwesịrị ime n'ụzọ ọzọ oge ọzọ? Nakọta echiche n'aka onye ọ bụla, gụnyere ihe gara nke ọma.
AI nwere ike ịhazi echiche ndị ahụ: "Kpokọta okwu ihe mmụta ndị a n'isiokwu ma dee ndụmọdụ atọ maka project ndị ga-abịa." Mee ka ọ bụrụ n'enweghị ịta ụta, lekwasị anya n'usoro, ma lelee na nchịkọta ahụ ziri ezi. Ọ bụrụ na ị chọrọ ito na njikwa project, Project Management Institute (PMI) na-enye asambodo dị ka CAPM, PMP na PMI-CPMAI gbasara AI; lelee pmi.org maka ihe a chọrọ na ụgwọ ugbu a.
Nzọụkwụ n'otu n'otu:
- Tụnyere ihe si na ya pụta na ebumnuche charter.
- Nyefee ọrụ na-aga n'ihu ma kwụọ ụgwọ ikpeazụ.
- Mee nnyocha ihe mmụta n'enweghị ịta ụta.
- Jiri AI kpokọta okwu ma dee ndụmọdụ mbụ.
- Chekwaa faịlụ niile ma kele ndị otu.
Okwu ị kwesịrị ịmara:
- Closeout (mmechi): njedebe project n'usoro kwesịrị ekwesị.
- Ihe mmụta (lessons learned): ihe ndị otu mụtara nke kwesịrị ịgbanwe otu a ga-esi duzie project ndị ga-abịa.
- After-action review: nlegharị anya azụ nwere usoro: e zubere, mere, ihe kpatara, ihe a ga-agbanwe.
Ebe ozi a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi:
- Project Management Institute: asambodo (certifications)
Nwaa ugbu a: Ọrụ ikpeazụ: mezuo atụmatụ project gị nwere charter, WBS, usoro oge nwere milestone, RACI, ndekọ ihe egwu na otu akụkọ ọnọdụ, wee dee ụkpụrụ ihe mmụta nwere ajụjụ nnyocha anọ ahụ. Kaa akara n'ebe ọ bụla i doziri AI.
Ugbu a ị nwere ike ịhazi, iduzi na imechi project site n'iji AI dee akwụkwọ mbụ mgbe gị onwe gị na-ekpebi ihe.
Otu e si enyocha ọrụ ikpeazụ gị:
Ihe anyị na-ele anya Ọ bụbeghị O ruru O karịrị Charter Ebumnuche, oke ọrụ, sponsor, ụbọchị njedebe ma ọ bụ ihe ịga nke ọma adịghị, ma ọ bụ nkọ AI ka dị n'ime ya. Otu peeji nwere akụkụ niile, ma kaa akara n'ebe ọ bụla e doziri AI. Ọ na-edepụtakwa ihe dị n'èzí oke ọrụ na otu a ga-esi tụọ ihe ịga nke ọma. WBS na usoro oge Ọrụ buru ibu nke ukwuu, ma ọ bụ milestone erughị anọ. Obere ọrụ, ọrụ dabere n'ibe ha na opekata mpe milestone anọ, ma lelee atụmatụ oge AI. E wuru usoro oge site na ụbọchị njedebe na-alaghachi azụ, nwere oge ndabere. Chaatị RACI Otu ọrụ enweghị onye Accountable ma ọ bụ nwere karịa otu. Naanị otu A n'ọrụ ọ bụla na ọrụ kesara n'ụzọ kwesịrị ekwesị. Ọ na-edekwa onye a ga-ajụ tupu isi mkpebi. Ndekọ ihe egwu Ihe egwu erughị ise, ma ọ bụ enweghị nzaghachi ma ọ bụ ndị nwe ha. Ihe egwu ise bụ eziokwu e tụrụ ọkwa ha, nke ọ bụla nwere nzaghachi na onye nwe ya. Ọ na-egosi mgbe a ga-elele ihe egwu ọ bụla na ihe ga-eme ka a malite ime ihe. Akụkọ ọnọdụ Agba ọnọdụ abụghị eziokwu, ma ọ bụ e leleghị ụbọchị na nọmba. Ọkara peeji nwere agba n'eziokwu, ọganihu, nzọụkwụ na-esote na mkpebi a chọrọ. Sponsor nwere ọrụ n'aka nwere ike ime ihe site na ya n'ime ihe na-erughị otu nkeji. Mmechi na ihe mmụta Enweghị ụkpụrụ ihe mmụta, ma ọ bụ ọ na-ata ndị mmadụ ụta. Ụkpụrụ n'enweghị ịta ụta nwere ajụjụ nnyocha anọ ahụ. Ọ na-ahazikwa otu a ga-esi tụnyere ihe si na ya pụta na charter na ebe a ga-echekwa faịlụ. Iji gafee: Ruru eru ma ọ bụ Karịrị n'ahịrị ọ bụla. Ọ bụrụ na ahịrị bụ Ọ ruchabeghị, dozie akụkụ ahụ ma nwaa ọzọ.

check.q: Gịnị bụ ebumnuche nnyocha ihe mmụta?
options: Ime ka usoro ka mma maka project na-esote
check.why: Ihe mmụta enweghị ịta ụta ma na-elekwasị anya n'ihe a ga-agbanwe oge ọzọ.

check.q: Project ahụ agwụla. Gịnị ka ị ga-eme tupu i kwuo na e mechiela ya?
options: Tụnyere ihe si na ya pụta na charter ma chekwaa faịlụ
check.why: Mmechi na-elele ihe si na ya pụta megide charter ma chekwaa ndekọ.
